'''September 2000 Parker tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Parker, CO on 30 September 2000. [[Brian Hunter]] won it. It is known from Brian Hunter's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1285">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-01-parker-co-9-30-00-jesus-goes-to-parkerd1285/ parker-co-9-30-00-jesus-goes-to-parker], DeckTech (Brian "HuntaWarya" Hunter, 1 October 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-01-parker-co-9-30-00-jesus-goes-to-parkerd1285/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 30 September 2000
* '''Site:''' Parker, CO
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Brian Hunter]]
